heroDescription: Cool cardamom-scented air, cedar-scented evenings, and an open sky. Find your quiet in the green hills of Kuttikanam.
introDescription: Wake to the mist drifting through the trees. Let cardamom-scented mountain air and long conversations by the fire slow everything down. A little comfort, tucked into the highlands of Idukki.
staySubheading: Three ways to make the mountains yours.
stayDescription: Every one with a view worth staying in for.
room1Description: Drift off beneath the stars in your own forest hideaway.
room2Description: A cosy hideout among the trees. Made for two.
room3Description: A little more room, a private deck, and the hills all around.
stayNote: Slow breakfasts, fireside evenings, and the cool, cardamom-scented air of Idukki come standard.
experienceDescription: Follow the winding paths through the trees. Out here, the best moments don’t need a schedule.
experience1Description: Take in the night sky with a warm drink and a blanket.
experience2Description: Settle in as the evening mist rolls over the hills.
experience3Description: Wander through the aromatic cardamom gardens and forest trails.
experience4Description: Fresh local flavours and slow mornings in the hills.
bookingPrompt: Choose your dates and tell us a little about your stay.
bookingAssurance: No booking fees. Just the good stuff.
bookingCaption: Your request will be sent to our team. We’ll confirm availability with you.
locationEyebrow: A WORLD AWAY. NOT VERY FAR.
locationDescription: High above the rush, among the green, tree-covered hills of Kuttikanam in Idukki, Kerala. Follow the scent of cardamom into the cool mountain air.
quote: We came for a night. We stayed long enough to remember what quiet feels like.
footerTagline: A little closer to the stars.
